## Expected and observed behavior

Describe one concrete trigger and its result.

## Reproduction

List the smallest steps or commands. Include a minimal fictional/sanitized fixture only when you have permission to share it. Do not attach a whole project ZIP by default.

## Environment and evidence

Record RoboPomelo package/spec version, Node version, OS, browser or agent host/version, and relevant exit/error codes. Distinguish source checkout, installed package and native host runs.

## Data check

- [ ] This report contains no confidential customer/facility data, personal information, credentials or bootstrap/session URLs.
- [ ] This is not a vulnerability report. Security details follow SECURITY.md.
